title: Recursive AI Engineering
goal: Evolve RAE into a recursively growing, context-efficient engineering system that operates through one manually started GPT conversation at a time.
summary: PR #28 remains Draft/unmerged. All four workflows passed on exact code head 29ce0773ded12b633aa1c6961db99c37e75206c1. Later node/checkpoint evidence commits are metadata-only; live PR HEAD must always be resolved from GitHub. PR #29 separately prepares the database routing/release fix and has its own pending independent review. No production deployment or merge has occurred.
